Incarnate in extreme worlds and live the chaos accompanied by loving mothers who are ready to do anything for their son.

You are shipwrecked on a deserted island and you must survive, fortunately by your side is your mother, the problem is not only to survive, but also that your imagination does not help you anymore to do your wank…

When problems beset the family and there is no solution.

A young mother would do anything to save the situation and the life of her son.

But what if the son isn’t willing to give as much, and what if he’s not willing to have his mother give everything for him?
